pages.title: Bariatric surgery consultation
lines: HPI: 54F w/ severe obesity since her 20s, T2DM on insulin, severe OSA on CPAP, HTN. Completed our 6-month medically supervised weight management program (01-07/2026) without meaningful loss. Interested in RYGB for diabetes control.
Vitals: Ht 65 in   Wt 265.6 lb   BMI 44.2 kg/m2   BP 138/84
Assessment: Class III obesity, BMI 44.2, w/ T2DM (A1c 8.1 on insulin), severe OSA, HTN.
Plan: laparoscopic Roux-en-Y gastric bypass. Psych and nutrition clearance obtained. Will schedule.

pages.title: Medically supervised weight management program summary
lines: Supervising physician: Kofi Ampofo, MD (Obesity Medicine)
Enrolled 01/08/2026, final visit 07/09/2026: 7 monthly physician/dietitian visits, all attended.

Interventions: 1,400 kcal meal plan with food logs; activity goal 150 min/wk (achieved ~90 min/wk due to knee pain); behavioral counseling; phentermine 15 mg 02/05-04/20/2026, stopped for BP elevation and palpitations. GLP-1 RA not added (already on insulin; pt declined injectable add-on, cost).
Weights: start 268.0 lb -> nadir 261.2 lb (05/2026) -> final 262.4 lb. Total loss 2.1%.
Outcome: did not achieve 5% weight loss goal. Medical management unsuccessful. Referred to bariatric surgery.

pages.title: Polysomnography summary
lines: Dx: severe obstructive sleep apnea. On CPAP since 04/2025, compliance 86% of nights >4h (09/2026 download).

pages.title: Psychological evaluation
lines: No current eating disorder; no binge eating. Mild depression in remission, no SI. Good support (husband, sister). Understands post-op diet and lifelong supplementation.
Recommendation: psychologically cleared for bariatric surgery.

lines: Active problems: T2DM since 2014, on insulin glargine 46 u + metformin; HTN on lisinopril 20 + amlodipine 5; severe OSA on CPAP; bilateral knee OA.

lines: BLUEBONNET BARIATRIC - OPERATIVE PLAN / LEVEL OF CARE
